chunks: Even if every soul that has sinned possessed whatever is on the earth, it would surely offer it to ransom itself, and feel repentant on seeing the punishment. Yet the sentence would be passed with justice, and not one will be wronged.
ai.seo_question: What will sinners offer to ransom themselves on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the futility of worldly wealth as a means of atonement on the Day of Judgment, contrasting material abundance with spiritual accountability. It highlights the transition from hidden remorse to visible despair, affirming that divine justice (Al-Adl) is absolute and leaves no room for partiality or error.
